label: first copy step of short i/y-h/v-?-w sequences
explanation: Extremely sparse (63 activations in 1M sequences), weak (max 0.175) conjunctive feature. About 87% of mass is at the first copy step (recall_idx 1, input = echoed first token), where the first original token is i or y, the token being output is h or v, w appears later in the original (usually position 3), and L is short (4-5). Top example: y h w w <DEL> [y] h w. A few weak activations happen in the original phase on the step right before <DEL> in sequences of the form h ... w .... Simple versions (recall_idx 1, output h/v, w in original) cover about 70% of mass but precision is under 1%, so the feature needs the specific token combination. Magnitude is highest for first_tok y with output h. Dev F1 is 0.43 with the full conjunction, which is likely partly overfit given only 30 dev activations.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 21 cues. Raise it: t=5 & in_tok=y (+2.11), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+2.04), prev2_tok=w (+2.00), orig3=w (+1.69), orig1=h (+1.57), orig4=w (+1.40). Lower it: next_out=- (-1.45), L=8 (-1.32), n_digits=1 (-0.94).
